error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect with those credentials. Check the host, API key, and dedicated account login.
error.no_sites: This UniFi account/API key has no sites available.

abort.wrong_account: These credentials point at a different UniFi site than this entry was set up for. Remove and re-add the integration if you meant to switch sites.

update_failing.title: Wi-Fi Watch can't reach UniFi
update_failing.description:
Wi-Fi Watch has been unable to fetch the client list from your UniFi controller for over a minute, so new devices aren't being detected. Last error: {error}

Check that the controller is reachable and the dedicated account's credentials are still valid, then this will clear on its own once polling succeeds again.

data_description.excluded_notify_targets: Every device below gets notified by default. Check any you want to silence - unpairing a phone removes it from this list automatically, no need to check it first.
data_description.poll_interval_seconds: How often the UniFi client list is checked.
data_description.notify_debounce_seconds: Minimum time between repeat alerts for the same device.
data_description.retention_window_seconds: How long history, denials, and notify records are kept.
data_description.token_expire_seconds: How long an approval link stays valid before it expires.
data_description.auto_block: Block a new device immediately instead of just notifying.
